# Recipe Reference

<!-- Generated by `python scripts/build_reference.py` from `sensoryforge describe --json`. Do not edit: change the code,
then run the command again. -->

The recipes that ship with SensoryForge: complete canonical configs you can run with `sensoryforge run --preset NAME`. Each entry is a digest of the recipe's grids and populations; [Presets](../user_guide/presets.md) explains how to run one, override it and add one, and [Units and gains](../user_guide/units_and_gains.md) says how its gains were set.

This page is generated from the shipped presets by `python scripts/build_reference.py`.

## `tactile_sa1_ra1` { #recipe-tactile-sa1-ra1 }

The pressure-simulation recipe: 80x80 grid at 0.15 mm, one SA and one RA population with template (designed) receptive fields at resolvable_distance_mm=0.40.

Grids:

| `name` | `arrangement` | `rows` | `cols` | `spacing` |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `"Main Grid"` | `"grid"` | `80` | `80` | `0.15` |

Populations:

| `name` | `neuron_model` | `neuron_type` | `filter_method` |
|---|---|---|---|
| `"SA Population"` | `"izhikevich"` | `"SA"` | `"sa"` |
| `"RA Population"` | `"izhikevich"` | `"RA"` | `"ra"` |

## `tactile_sa1_ra1_adex` { #recipe-tactile-sa1-ra1-adex }

The pressure-simulation recipe on AdEx neurons: identical to tactile_sa1_ra1 but neuron_model=AdEx, resolving to the SA1_tonic and RA1_phasic presets by neuron_type.

Grids:

| `name` | `arrangement` | `rows` | `cols` | `spacing` |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `"Main Grid"` | `"grid"` | `80` | `80` | `0.15` |

Populations:

| `name` | `neuron_model` | `neuron_type` | `filter_method` |
|---|---|---|---|
| `"SA Population"` | `"AdEx"` | `"SA"` | `"sa"` |
| `"RA Population"` | `"AdEx"` | `"RA"` | `"ra"` |

## `tactile_stochastic_control` { #recipe-tactile-stochastic-control }

Named control arm: identical to tactile_sa1_ra1 but with gaussian/use_distance_weights=false (stochastic, uniform-random weight) receptive fields instead of the designed template.

Grids:

| `name` | `arrangement` | `rows` | `cols` | `spacing` |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `"Main Grid"` | `"grid"` | `80` | `80` | `0.15` |

Populations:

| `name` | `neuron_model` | `neuron_type` | `filter_method` |
|---|---|---|---|
| `"SA Population"` | `"izhikevich"` | `"SA"` | `"sa"` |
| `"RA Population"` | `"izhikevich"` | `"RA"` | `"ra"` |

## `vision_onoff_rgb` { #recipe-vision-onoff-rgb }

Generality demo: one 3-channel (R, G, B) grid; one population reads R and G through OnOffLayer and sums, one reads all three and concatenates.

Grids:

| `name` | `arrangement` | `rows` | `cols` | `spacing` | `channels` |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `"RGB Grid"` | `"grid"` | `32` | `32` | `0.15` | `["R", "G", "B"]` |

Populations:

| `name` | `neuron_model` | `neuron_type` | `filter_method` |
|---|---|---|---|
| `"RG OnOff Population"` | `"izhikevich"` | `"SA"` | `"sa"` |
| `"RGB Concat Population"` | `"izhikevich"` | `"SA"` | `"sa"` |
